items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: I'd always tell Earl, say, look make this a flat fifth.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. Well, that's what was in their head.

But now they can hear anything, guys here -- augmented flats, 18 fifths and everything now. They know just what you're doing. And that was a little edge I had on them with the Basie band, (inaudible) was in the band. They say, we hear a peculiar sound in this reed section in that background. That's when I used to use organ harmony a lot, because you can dissolve odd sounds, and I'd always tell Earl, say, look make this a flat fifth. I'd say, but I don't want to put the accidentally in front of it, because --…
